column2: Boy! I'll go with you! You've given me the will to power up! But I refuse to team up with the Shutendoji!
Hand over the giant weapon?
An operation is underway in here right now... When this operation is over... people will know the greatness of science!
Iron Kaiser?\n\nNo good. He's so wrapped up in his thoughts, he's not listening.
That weapon!?\n\nWith that, I could power up even more!
(Kukai Jawanbo...?\n\nThat's the oni descendant who attacked us on the way to the Dark Temple... This guy must have been watching the fight from nearby...)
Oh? You're the boy who was with Jiro Shutendo, aren't you?
Head west from here and you'll find the trail up into the Japanese Alps.
Lately the mountain weather just keeps getting worse... It's like it's trying to keep people away.
I saw a pale-faced young fella heading for the trail. He was muttering, "Who's there? Who's calling me!?"
There's nobody here.
A photo... What a cute girl. "With my sister Saori"... !? There's a diary too. Ryo Utsugi... It's her brother's diary... Should I... read it?

Let's see...

"I had the same dream again.

The same dream for over a month now. A dream of a huge monster buried in ice inside a giant crevasse. A dream of a devil attacking and devouring people... The devil's face turns into my face! My body grows enormous!"

Led by the voice, I've finally come all the way to the snowy mountains. Maybe it's my imagination, but the voice seems to come from the west. I think I'll head west now. And then... I want to hurry home to Saori, who's waiting... Head west... Want to go home... Utsugi-san...
It's not right to read someone's diary without asking.
It's Utsugi-san's diary. Should I read it after all?
The blizzard's swirling!?\n\nThere seems to be a windless path open right in the middle of the vortex.
It's just a rumor, but somebody saw a monster on the trail. It looked just like a devil, they say...
They say there's a cave at the end of the trail, but if you value your life, stay away. Nobody who's gone in there has come back alive.
Where... is this?
The depths of the Himalayas...
I am Medossa.\n\nThe lover of Demon Lord Dante, and his protector...
Demon Lord Dante?
For a million years, Dante has called out by telepathy.
He's been calling by telepathy for a million years...?
At last a young man has appeared who answered, and was able to come this far. Dante's awakening is near! Turn back!\n\nOtherwise, you will die...
...No good, the door won't open. Let's give up on this one.
What amazing equipment... Could it be more advanced than Science City?
Something came up on the monitor!?
Where!? Where are you!?
Ryo Utsugi! Ally of Demon Lord Dante! Lend me your strength!
I am imprisoned... in the ice!
In the ice? ...I saw it in my dream! I saw you in my dream! You're a monster! Demon Lord Dante!
No, I am human! I have a human heart and human reason! Ryo Utsugi! Ally of Demon Lord Dante! Lend me your strength!
I'm... an ally...
You must lend your strength to Dante!
I... must lend my strength...\n\nYes, I must lend my strength... to Dante!!
Destroy that machine! The machine that seals Dante's power!
RAAAAAAAAH!!
Oh no! It looks like that guy's mind is being controlled!
Words came up on the monitor... Let's see? Forced release of restraint system!?\n\nIf the auxiliary power isn't started, Demon Lord Dante will revive...!?
It won't open!? There must be a switch somewhere!
{!R}Whoaaaaaaa!
Ryo Utsugi! I am Dante, Demon Lord Dante!
Y-you controlled my mind!\n\nYou twisted my mind and made me help you!
Your mind was controlled because your heart is weak! Gahahahahaha!
Ryo Utsugi, I thank you for your help!\n\nYou did well to revive Demon Lord Dante!
What do you mean to do now that you've come back to this world, Demon Lord Dante!?
First... I'll eat you!\n\nThen I'll wipe out every human on the face of the earth!
You used me... to wipe out humanity!?
To Demon Lord Dante, humans are the enemy! All the humans in the world! Starting... with you!
Oh no!
This is...! The clothes Utsugi-san was wearing just now...!? Huh!?
I'm... alive? Why!? That monster devoured me... I should be dead!
This body! It's that devil's form!\n\nAm I... no longer Ryo Utsugi!? Have I... become Demon Lord Dante!?
GUOOOOOOOH!
{!R}(U-Utsugi-san...)
Heh heh heh heh... Heh heh heh heh... Gahahahahaha!
Wahahahahaha! I'm not human anymore! I'm a monster, I'm a devil!
Could this machine be the auxiliary power switch!?
All right! It's working!?
{!R}...! More words on the monitor...!? {!R}Auxiliary power startup initiated... Hey, wait a minute!
Who are you...? Where are you watching from...!
No, it doesn't matter who you are. I have a favor to ask... Kill me.
Erase this hideous form of mine from the world!
{!R}I-I can't do that...!
What's wrong, can't you kill me? Can't erase me? If you can't erase me, then I'll erase all of you! Every last one, from the whole world! Every last human!!
GUOOOOOOOH!\n\nTh-this is freezing gas...! Yes... this is... this is for the best...!
Grrrr... Curse you...!
With this, I'll be... back in the ice...!\n\nGUOOOOOOOH!
{!R}(Looks like he's completely sealed in the ice. {!R}I'm sorry, Utsugi-san... I couldn't do anything...!)

{!R}...Huh? Ryo Utsugi...? I've heard that name... {!R}...That's it! The guy whose diary I read in the tent! {!R}The dream of a huge monster buried in ice... being called here by a voice... {!R}And wanting to hurry home to Saori-san, who's waiting...
Saori...?\n\nSaori... my sister...
{!R}That's right, Utsugi-san!\n\n{!R}Are you going to erase your sister from the world too!?
This form, this power... I'm a monster now! A devil!
{!R}Utsugi-san! Listen to me!
...The Dimension Chain?\n\nAt this rate the world will be destroyed... Then so be it!
{!R}You can't mean that...!
If it means this ugly form disappears from the earth...
{!R}Your sister might disappear too!
...That's right. You're right... This is a tragedy that happened to me. Saori has nothing to do with it!
{!R}Utsugi-san!
Even after I've become this, you still call me by the name Ryo Utsugi... I'll go with you!\n\nI'll use Dante's demonic power for Saori, and for the world!
I'll go with you!\n\nI'll use Dante's demonic power for Saori, and for the world!
I'm back to my normal form!? It's thanks to you!
Thank you. I'll go with you, and I'll surely put this power to use for you! When we fight giant enemies, I'll transform and lend a hand too!
WHOAAAAAA!!
Boy, what is your name...?
{p}, I'm grateful to you. I don't want to live in this hideous form. And I certainly don't want my kindhearted sister Saori to see me like this...
Thank you, {p}...
Demon Lord Dante... So your mind has been taken over by Ryo Utsugi...
And if it has?
...I sense great willpower in you.
A strong spirit that yields to no one.\n\nThat is what makes Demon Lord Dante who he is! Medossa will follow you.
